transcript:
Header: Redwood Inference - March 2026 All-Hands
Date: 2026-03-09 10:00 PT | Duration: 62 minutes
Attendees: Ethan, Priya, Liam, Maya, Carlos, Janelle + whole company (notes below)

[00:00] Ethan Brooks: alright good morning everyone, uh quick housekeeping we've got the recording on, captions enabled. we'll try to keep this to about an hour.
[00:18] Ethan Brooks: first off shout-out to infra and support — last week was rough with the Dedicated tier incident, but team response was solid. i want to give a quick update on lessons learned.
[00:30] Priya Patel: yeah so, um the incident was caused primarily by a kernel regression in one of our optimized runtimes, um that led to memory fragmentation on a subset of hosts, it cascaded into autoscaler thrashing. we rolled the rollback at 03:15 and restored capacity by about 03:40.
[00:48] Employee 1 (someone from infra): and we added a guardrail, a metric on kernel mem usage, plus an automated rollback hook so future regressions don't take as long.
[01:05] Ethan Brooks: thanks, i think the thing for leadership is, customers were impacted but SLA credits were minimal, most customers accepted the post-incident plan, but we need to do better on communication windows.
[01:20] Priya Patel: action items — postmortem, publish this week, contact customers with tailored notes.
[01:28] Maya Singh: on product, quick wins: Redwood Optimize beta is on track, we've got 12 pilot customers signed, the beta will include batching recommendations, quantization profiles and a UI for cost/latency tradeoffs.
[01:45] Employee 2 (product): small caveat, the UI for per-route suggestions needs another iteration based on SE feedback.
[02:00] Liam Chen: engineering update — we've throttled some non-critical background jobs, optimized the KV cache eviction heuristics, and improved continuous batching throughput by about 14% in our internal benchmarks. still working on latency tail.
[02:20] Ethan Brooks: revenue and GTM — quick numbers, Q1 ARR pull-through is slightly above plan, net retention is 112% for the quarter, we closed a couple of mid-market pilots. Carlos?
[02:36] Carlos Rivera: yea, signed two notable customers: a fintech pilot that needs Private on-prem later this year, and a healthcare customer that's very focused on SOC2 plus additional contractual audit needs. Sales is pushing an enterprise playbook and we'll need legal + security to help streamline the process.
[02:52] Janelle Park: hiring update — we are freezing most IC hiring for non-critical roles for next 6 weeks to align runway; we will prioritize infra, security, and a few key product hires. parental leave policy update coming this week.
[03:10] Ethan Brooks: ok questions, start with ops and product.
[03:20] (Q) Employee 3: is the Dedicated outage related to customer VPC/private deployments?
[03:27] Priya Patel: no, this was in our hosted control plane and runtime. Private customers were not affected. we did validate the same kernel path exists in some private images, so we'll coordinate a scan for customers who self-host.
[03:45] (Q) Employee 4: what's the timeline for Redwood Optimize GA?
[03:50] Maya Singh: beta in April, GA plan is late Q2 assuming beta telemetry looks good. we'll be aggressive on pruning model profiles and adding recommended quantization presets by GA.
[04:05] (Q) Employee 5: any changes to Dedicated pricing given the reliability hit?
[04:12] Carlos Rivera: no immediate price changes; we're looking at new committed capacity discounts and a clearer SLA addendum; we'll share proposed carrier tiers with sales by mid-March.
[04:28] Ethan Brooks: product demo highlight — Priya, can you walk through the new rollout features?
[04:35] Priya Patel: sure, short demo: rollouts now support canary + A/B split by percentage and automatic fallback to a compatible variant. we've added tracing hooks so a failing variant auto-routes to a lower-cost but compatible model. demo had a small audio glitch earlier, so apologies if the recorded clip in the deck is choppy.
[05:05] (natural speech, overlap) Employee voices: mm-hmm, uh-huh, yep
[05:15] Priya Patel: also adding per-route cost estimates in the console, that will help SEs show customers the unit economics tradeoff in sales cycles.
[05:30] Ethan Brooks: wanted to reiterate the product thesis — we're doubling down on serving and economics controls. customers pick Redwood because they want predictable unit cost across hosted/dedicated/private. we'll keep building features that directly reduce per-token cost without sacrificing quality.
[06:00] (long section: Q&A and shoutouts — condensed)
[06:15] Employee 6 (sales): how are we handling compliance requests — e.g. custom audit logs for a regulated healthcare customer?
[06:22] Maya Singh: security is working on a compliance bundle: SSO/SAML integration doc, SOC2 artifacts, and an audit log export. we'll offer a paid add-on for extended retention.
[06:35] Priya Patel: for private deployments we have improved KMS integration and documented HSM flows; we need to scope a couple more end-to-end test cases for on-prem packaging.
[06:50] Ethan Brooks: ok let's do three quick wins before the next all-hands — 1) postmortem published, 2) Optimize beta sign-up, 3) hiring update and parental leave note.
[07:05] (misc chatter, applause)
[07:12] (Sequence of updates continues — internal commentary, recognition shout-outs)
[07:40] Ethan Brooks: recognition time — shout out to infra team (named) and to Carlos for closing the fintech deal, to Priya's team for the runtime fix.
[08:00] (Detailed engineer comments, some cross talk, minor transcript errors)
[12:30] (mid meeting breakouts referenced)
[20:00] (back from breakout — product & sales sync summary)
[23:45] Maya Singh: On community and open source — we're going to release two reference deployment templates for Private in April, community contributions welcome.
[27:10] Priya Patel: on telemetry — we're exposing more per-token instrumentation. that should help customers debug tail latency spikes, and enable Optimize to make better batching suggestions.
[31:00] (Audience question) Employee 7: will we support more model variants e.g. 4-bit quantized variants for small enterprise customers?
[31:15] Liam Chen: yes the runtime roadmap includes 4-bit quant paths; however we need to validate quality regressions on a per-model basis; Optimize will include recommended aggressiveness levels.
[35:00] (Discussion about region expansion)
[36:20] Carlos Rivera: APAC momentum is growing, we've got two partners evaluating marketplace listings. we'd like Marketing to help prioritize localized content and compliance messaging.
[38:05] Marketing rep: noted — we'll prioritize a partner case study and a compliance brief.
[40:00] (People update) Janelle Park: reminder about the volunteer day and the upcoming benefits Q&A; also the hiring freeze note — managers please prioritize backfill requests only for customer-impacting roles.
[42:00] (Finance snippet) Ethan Brooks: runway remains in the healthy band, we tightened hiring to extend runway through end of 2027 in the base plan; revenue growth still a top priority.
[44:30] (Security deep dive mention)
[45:00] Priya Patel: Security -> we'll run a tabletop next week for breach response, invitees will be product, legal, support, se, and infra.
[45:30] (Question) Employee 8: what's the plan for major feature rollouts to minimize customer churn?
[45:40] Maya Singh: rolling features behind flags, canarying on low-risk tenants and using automatic fallbacks. we'll codify the rollout checklist and share with SEs.
[46:20] (Closing remarks)
[46:30] Ethan Brooks: thank you everyone; recap: postmortem, Optimize beta, hiring/policy notes; expect follow-ups in slack and a doc in #all-hands. next all-hands will be late April.
[46:50] (Next steps readout)
[47:00] Priya Patel: i'll kick off the postmortem draft today and share to the incident channel.
[47:10] Carlos Rivera: sales will send proposed SLA addendum by 3/18.
[47:20] Maya Singh: product will open beta form and share pilot onboarding checklist.
[47:30] (Meeting ends, applause)

Notes: Transcription contains minor errors (names and acronyms occasionally mis-transcribed). Links referenced during the meeting: (1) Q1 revenue deck (link in slack), (2) Dedicated outage incident doc (private link), (3) Redwood Optimize beta sign-up form (internal).
